name: Machine torso rotation
instructions: Set the start position so you face one side.
Sit tall with your knees held between the leg pads.
Turn your upper body to the other side using your core.
Rotate back slowly, then switch the start side for the next set.
cue: Turn from the middle, slow and steady
mistakes: Swinging fast so momentum does the work.
Rounding the back while you turn.
